content.comment_body: Hello, I am using [product_name] [version_no] and typically connect via USB cable ([article_no]) to communicate with [product_name]. I am able to connect to other [product_name] modules, but cannot connect to this one ([article_no]). I also cannot access the stop menu on the [product_name] display—it only shows "Set clock" and "Set param" options. The error I receive in [product_name] is: Unable to access the IP address COM8. The issue does not seem to be with my PC because if I swap the cable and connect to another [product_name] module—without altering the software—I am able to upload successfully.
For older [product_name] modules, the procedure is different. You can find relevant information in the manual for [article_no], specifically in Chapter 7 (page 145). See [url] for details.
Thank you. The issue is resolved.

analysis.insight_summary: A user faced connectivity problems between their PC and a particular [product_name] module using [product_name] [version_no] and a [company_name] USB cable. The setup worked with other modules, but not this one, and access to some menu features was restricted. Another user clarified that older [product_name] modules require a different approach and referred to the product manual, which resolved the matter.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable and uncomplicated connectivity and menu accessibility with all [product_name] modules using their current cable and software.
